# MatrixQR Digital Menu Generator

> Free, secure, client-side online tool that converts physical menu images into scannable digital QR codes for restaurants, cafes, and bars.

## Core Features

- **Instant Image-to-QR**: Convert JPG, PNG, or WEBP menu images (up to 10MB) into scannable QR codes instantly.
- **Privacy & Security**: 100% client-side execution — menu image data and generated codes are never uploaded to remote servers.
- **Free & Frictionless**: Unlimited usage with no user registration, payment, or account creation required.
- **Mobile Friendly**: Optimized for quick scanning and seamless display on iOS and Android devices.
